title: Born Into a Family Without Love | My Silent Childhood Story #YouAreNotAlone
description:
I was born into a family where love was never meant for me.
No hugs, no comfort, no words of encouragement — only silence and emotional distance.

This is not a story to blame anyone.
This is a story for those who grew up feeling invisible, unheard, and unloved.

If you’ve ever felt alone even when surrounded by family, this story is for you.
You are not weak. You are surviving. #ChildhoodTrauma
